question: The positions of the first and fourth letters in the word 'QUIRKY' are interchanged. Similarly the positions of the second and fifth letters are interchanged and in the same pattern the positions of the third and sixth letters are interchanged. If all letters are counted from left to right, then which letter will be the fourth letter from the right in the word so formed?
solution:
**Given word:** QUIRKY

According to the question, the positions of the first and fourth letters in the given word are interchanged. Similarly the positions of the second and fifth letters are interchanged and in the same pattern the positions of the third and sixth letters are interchanged:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/317b105c6192bb4a8cb85589ad1aa95753e6eecdd0ed0119c457475b358479ce.png] 

So, letter that will be the fourth letter from the right in the word so formed:

(Left) R K __**Y**__ Q U I (Right) ⇒ Y

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
